title: 015 旋风管家人气王！怎么能没有管家呢
slug: 少女大召唤全本免费-少女大召唤最新章节列表
content_zh:
如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    白皇学院真不愧是这个世界赫赫有名的贵族学院，就算除去那大的不像话的面积还有那看起来像别墅多过像教学楼的建筑，它也不是普通的高档次啊…
别的不说，单单是那超高的入学门槛，就足以拦住大部分慕名而来的学生了，这一点，从白皇学院的入学考试试卷之中就可以看得出来了。
就连已经把所有的书本内容给背下来的无言，也不敢说自己能得到优秀以上的分数，别人就更不敢想象了，无言不知道是不是因为自己得罪了那个神经大姐的缘故所以才拿到那么一份难度超高的试卷，但是那确实很难就对了。
虽然如此，但是拿个及格分数，无言还是信心满满的，这让无言不禁心中感概，以前那个视试卷如猛兽的自己，将永远不再回来了，拥有‘完全记忆’能力，试卷什么的，都是浮云…
接下来，只要自己乖乖的等白皇学院的入学通知书下来就可以了…
不过现在，另一个困难却摆在了无言的面前，原因是桂雪路的一句话。
“留下你的地址，到时候，通知书会有专人送过去的。”
是的，这是很正常的一件事，留下地址，很正常的一件事嘛，毕竟白皇学院也不可能为了你一个人，专门派人审查你的试卷，而且要准备入学通知书，也是需要时间的，大概两三天的时间。
而这两三天的时间，难道你能在学校里等？
所以留下地址，只是一个手续而已。
问题是，无言没有地址啊！
他来到这个世界还不满一天，哪里有住的地方啊…
随便写下一个地址？不是不可以，但是无言不知道这通知书什么时候发下来，他也不可能一直呆在一个地方等一张通知书啊…
于是乎，无言陷入了不大不小的烦恼之中。
只不过是一个地址而已…有必要烦恼吗…
“怎么了？又有问题？”雏菊已经习惯了无言时不时的发生一些问题了。
无言看着靓丽的会长大人，眼珠子一转，心中闪过一计。
只见他吧嗒一声单膝跪倒在雏菊的面前，愣是把天不怕地不怕就怕高和胸部小的会长大人给吓了一跳，还不等雏菊反应过来，无言就摆了一个礼，一脸严肃的说道。
“您需要管家吗？”…
“哈？”雏菊已经完全跟不上无言的思维了，这又是闹哪样啊？

“嘛，雏菊，你就让我当你的管家吧。”果然，无言是不可能正经的起来的，才不过一秒，他就又恢复了一脸吊儿郎当的模样，摊了摊自己的手，无言笑嘻嘻的说道。
“当我的管家？”雏菊指着自己的鼻子，一脸的讶异，虽然身在白皇学院这样到处都是有钱人家的贵族学院里，但说到底，雏菊不过是一个稍微富有一点的家庭的孩子，跟管家什么的，是一点关系也扯不上的。
而且，我们的会长大人是出了名的能干，要不然也不会当上强人满地的白皇学院学生会会长了，从来就没有想过要招管家。
无缘无故多出来了这么一个人，想要做自己这样完全不需要管家的存在的管家，这让雏菊有点怀疑，无言是不是另有企图。
“是的！当你的管家！”无言正色的说道：“贵族学校白皇学院的学生会会长，怎么能没有自己的管家呢，所以我要当你的管家！”
“可是…我并不需要管家啊，而且，我也聘不起管家，别看我这样，其实我家跟那些超有钱的人家是没有办法比的，我并不是大小姐…”雏菊一脸头疼的对着无言说道，说实话，对于无言突然的举动，雏菊到现在都还跟不上来，明明之前还在谈的是入学的事的说。
“没关系的，我并不需要工资，所以你完全可以放心！”
不，你这么说之后，我就更不能放心了…
雏菊很想这么吐槽，免费的工人，而且还是自愿的，说没有什么企图，别人也不相信啊。
“这怎么行呢！不要工资什么的…”当下，雏菊便有点警惕的对着无言说道，那样子，就好像是在防狼。
“这并不重要，重要的是…”抬起头来，无言看向雏菊，原本还正色着的脸，顿时被泪水给充满，一副遗弃小孩状，可怜没人要的样子。
“我没有地方可以去了！”
“……”看着变脸比变戏法还快的无言，结合从他嘴中出来，那天雷滚滚令她淡定不能的话语，雏菊嘴角不断的抽搐着。

content_en:
If this book infringes upon your rights, please click to access the author's quick channel for copyright complaints. White Emperor College is indeed a famous aristocratic college in the world. Even if you remove the ridiculously large area and the building that looks more like a villa than a teaching building, it is not an ordinary high-end...
Apart from anything else, the extremely high admission threshold alone is enough to deter most students from coming here. This can be seen from the entrance examination papers of Baihuang Academy.
Even Wu Yan, who had memorized all the contents of the book, did not dare to say that he could get a score above excellent, let alone others. Wu Yan didn't know if it was because he offended that crazy sister that he got such a very difficult test paper, but it was indeed very difficult.
Even so, Wu Yan was still full of confidence after getting a passing grade, which made Wu Yan couldn't help but feel that the self who used to treat the test papers like wild beasts would never come back again. With the ability of "complete memory", the test papers and everything else were just clouds...
Next, all I have to do is wait patiently for the admission notice from White Emperor Academy to come out...
But now, another difficulty is placed in front of Wuyan, and the reason is Gui Xuelu's words.
"Leave your address and a notification will be sent by someone when the time comes."
Yes, this is a normal thing. It is normal to leave your address. After all, it is impossible for Baihuang College to send someone to review your test papers just for you. Moreover, it also takes time to prepare the admission notice, about two or three days.
And can you wait at school for these two or three days?
So leaving your address is just a formality.
The problem is, Wuyan doesn’t have an address!
He has been in this world for less than a day. Where can he find a place to live...
Just write down an address? It's not impossible, but Wu Yan doesn't know when the notice will be sent out, and he can't stay in one place forever waiting for a notice...
As a result, Wu Yan fell into a lot of troubles.
It's just an address... is there any need to worry...
"What's wrong? Is there another problem?" Daisy has become accustomed to Wuyan having problems from time to time.
Wu Yan looked at the beautiful president, rolled his eyes, and had a plan in his mind.
I saw him kneel down on one knee in front of Daisy with a click, which startled the President, who is not afraid of anything but height and small breasts. Before Daisy could react, he silently bowed and said with a serious face.
"Do you need a housekeeper?"…
"Huh?" Daisy couldn't keep up with Wu Yan's thoughts. What's going on?
"Well, Daisy, just let me be your housekeeper." Sure enough, it was impossible for Wu Yan to be serious. In just a second, he returned to his carefree look, spread his hands, and said with a smile.
"Be my butler?" Daisy pointed to her nose with a surprised look on her face. Although she was in an aristocratic college like White Emperor Academy where there were rich families everywhere, in the final analysis, Daisy was just a child from a slightly richer family and had nothing to do with being a butler.
Moreover, our president is famously capable, otherwise he would not have become the president of the powerful White Emperor College Student Union. He has never thought of recruiting a housekeeper.
There was such an extra person for no reason, and he wanted to be a housekeeper like himself who didn't need a housekeeper at all. This made Daisy wonder if Wu Yan had other intentions.
"Yes! Be your butler!" Wuyan said sternly: "How can the student union president of the aristocratic White Emperor Academy not have his own butler, so I want to be your butler!"
"But...I don't need a butlerAh, and I can't afford a housekeeper. Don't look at me like this. In fact, there is no way my family can compare with those super rich families. I am not a eldest lady..." Daisy said to Wuyan with a headache on her face. To be honest, Daisy still couldn't keep up with Wuyan's sudden move. It was obvious that she was still talking about enrolling in school.
"It's okay, I don't need a salary, so you can rest assured! "
No, after you said that, I can’t rest assured anymore...
Daisy really wanted to complain like this, the workers were free, and they were voluntary. If they said they had no intentions, others wouldn't believe them.
"How can this be done! No salary or anything..." At that moment, Daisy said to Wuyan a little warily, as if she was guarding against wolves.
"It's not important. What's important is..." He raised his head and looked at Daisy without saying anything. His face, which was still calm, was suddenly filled with tears, looking like an abandoned child, pitiful and undesired.
“I have nowhere to go! "
"..." Looking at Wu Yan, who changed his face faster than a magic trick, and combined with the words that came out of his mouth, the thunderous words that made her calm and helpless that day, the corners of Daisy's mouth kept twitching.
